## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Semantic model
- [ ] Terminology
- [ ] Syntax
- [ ] Grammar
- [ ] Examples
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling
- [ ] Other

## Validation

Explain how the change was evaluated.

For semantic changes, include at least one example and, where useful, a counterexample or ambiguity it resolves.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped and focused.
- [ ] The change does not introduce unnecessary implementation-specific concepts.
- [ ] Established semantics and proposals are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where necessary.
